title: Advanced Golems: Retextured
description: A resourcepack of Improved textures of the Advanced Golems mod to look consistent with minecraft's vanilla textures.
body:
# ![arrow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f296ca2ec3e48bfcf91c4e9ff5b41a60a1a1f40f.png) About
This resourcepack retextures most texture assets of the [Advanced Golems](https://modrinth.com/mod/advanced-golems) mod to be vanilla-like while staying true to the mod author's original textures.

# ![arrow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f296ca2ec3e48bfcf91c4e9ff5b41a60a1a1f40f.png) Misc.

<details>
<summary>⚙️ Installation</summary>

1. Download and install the [Advanced Golems](https://modrinth.com/mod/advanced-golems) mod.
1. Download the [resourcepack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/advanced-golems-retextured/versions).
1. Copy the downloaded respourcepack's .zip file.
1. In your `.minecraft` directory go to the `resourcepacks` folder.
1. Paste the resourcepack's .zip into the `resourcepacks` folder.
1. Open Minecraft and activate the resourcepack.

</details>
